sections.Profile:
"Space Station," released by Williams in 1987, was designed by Barry Oursler and features artwork by Tim Elliot. This pinball machine offers a unique gameplay experience with two flippers, three pop bumpers, and a variety of targets, including three- and four-bank stand-up targets. It is notable for its distinctive "Space Station" model and the innovative general illumination that changes from white to green during multiball modes, enhancing the sci-fi theme. The game lacks traditional flipper inlanes, which adds to the challenge.
